annotation.title_clean: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market
annotation.title_en: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 404/2
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative-initiative resolution recommending that the Commission propose a Digital Services Act revising the E-Commerce Directive. It covers notice-and-action, platform transparency, online marketplace liability, ex ante rules for gatekeepers, and AI/automated decision-making transparency and human oversight. It has no embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Harmonised, legally binding notice-and-action mechanism for illegal content, preserving safe harbours and the ban on general monitoring
Consumers must be informed when interacting with AI or automated decision-making, with a right to human review and redress
Algorithm transparency, non-discrimination, external audits and 'human in command' principle
Stronger liability and product-safety duties for online marketplaces, including know-your-business-customer
Separate ex ante instrument for systemic gatekeeper platforms and a hybrid EU/national supervisory model
